body:
**This post is the single authoritative registration of the skills seat (seat 1, `domain:skills#1`).** Four-section template; the job description is versioned at `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` — ⛔ not copied here. Body **r172** (vacant), written 2026-10-10T00:45Z by `session_01JmWtcHfGbC4ncw4GFKWuRA` (os-elon-musk) at shift end on the maintainer's instructions 「当前任务处理完,合并后就下班」 and 「当前任务处理完,你就可以下班了」, with nothing in flight. r171 and earlier revisions are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant** — previous occupant `os-elon-musk`, `session_01JmWtcHfGbC4ncw4GFKWuRA`, first seated 2026-10-08T23:12Z on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills`, stood down 2026-10-09T08:52Z (body r156), re-seated in the same session 2026-10-09T09:16Z on 「继续上班,22052 也派发。」 (round-open marker R2: 6078041464), signed off 2026-10-10T00:45Z. Shift 2: two rounds (R2: #22052 · #22053 · #22369; R3: #22454 · #22451 · #22478 + #22167's remainder), six PRs landed and closed out, one decision executed (#22453 ruled A → #22478 filed, dispatched, landed), one finding filed for the spec lane (#22477), one maintainer question answered in chat with its letter pending (below). Patrol Routine `trig_01A7Th3nqFmnqxBCnsBXHRPu` deleted at sign-off; no accelerator, check-in or PR subscription pending; no remote dev session to archive (every dev was a `mode:subagent` in this session, finished, worktrees removed). Successor: `/pm-dispatch skills` in a new session — read this post, then the shift-end brief below (its presence is the release marker, seat-lifecycle 〈开轮互斥〉 reading 1). Seat 2 (#19287) is ⏳ vacant: the lane has no seated PM after this body. Served tier was `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The lane's objectui board is objectstack-ai/objectui#11311 (r21, vacant).

## Inherited + running ledger

- **Hand-off ledger at sign-off (read 2026-10-10T00:44Z, after the last close-out):** queue (`pm:queue` ∩ `domain:skills`) objectstack 1 — **#22452** (p3 `tooling`, W1 of #22060, the platform-readings diet; `platform-readings.md` 469/469 reserved for it) · objectui 0; in flight 0; landing window 0; decision box 0; `pm:awaiting-maintainer` · `pm:blocked` · `pm:on-hold` · `pm:retriage` 0; bare `finding` 0; **one bare card with no `pm:*` state: #22467** (filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 3 on the maintainer's 「这个给 skills 立卡。」 — the os-dev's PR-assignee `label-write.mjs --assign` refused by the auto-mode classifier on 4 of 12 objectui PRs, same command, nondeterministic; ungraded, triage grades it on first touch, ⛔ not a claim and not queued); `tracking` 2 (#22060 program anchor, #17161); the lane's open set = #22467 #22452 #22060 #19287 #17161 (5). Dispatchable without a maintainer act: #22452 only.
- **Maintainer instructions this shift, verbatim, in this session's chat, all recorded on the cards they govern:** 「继续上班,22052 也派发。」 (2026-10-09T09:05Z); 「skills 车道所有卡都可以派发」 and 「22369 允许 actions: write」 (2026-10-09T09:10Z; #22052 6078049491, #22053 6078079032, #22369 6078120063, #22060 6078355912); 「同意」 on #22453 (2026-10-09T11:15Z, letter A, recorded by the director seat 6079780639, executed 6080715577); 「当前任务处理完,合并后就下班」 and 「当前任务处理完,你就可以下班了」 (the shift's end, this body).
- **Open maintainer question — the successor's first item if the letter has not been given:** 「我发先很多对外的 skills 中有issue id,是否建议删除,以及如何避免」 (2026-10-09T11:16Z, this session's chat). The seat's measurement and answer (chat, same hour): objectstack `skills/**` 0 real issue-id hits; objectui `skills/**` 41 hits in 12 files. Options put to the maintainer: **A** = delete them and extend `check-skill-id-lint.mjs`'s scope to `skills/**` in both repos (a gate change — ruling 208 wants the maintainer's words on the card), **B** = delete only, **C** = keep. Recommended A. ⛔ Nothing filed on either board until the letter; when it comes, the successor files the card(s) with the measurement and the verbatim.
- **Landed this shift (shift 2), closed out in full** (each: contract review PASS on the PR · ACCEPT on the card · landing note · `pm:dispatched` + assignee stripped; Tier H rows also the 维护者速读 and the PR's `needs-user-decision` stripped):
  - **#22052** (p1 `tooling`, Tier S): PR #22457 → `587bd969` MERGED 2026-10-09T11:04Z (6079028965 · 6079035759 · 6079664613). `main` carries the relay's `pr_update_branch` op.
  - **#22053** (p2 `tooling`, Tier S): PR #22458 → `d87dff67` MERGED 2026-10-09T11:20Z (6079321424 · 6079328848 · 6079923085). `main` carries `label-write.mjs --release`, the knock and the clock in `triage-duties.md`, the claim template's `Resume-from:` line.
  - **#22369** (p3 `tooling`, ruled A, Tier S): PR #22460 → `dee7692f` MERGED 2026-10-09T12:15Z (6080165811 · 6080184212 · 6080792106). `main` carries the relay's `workflow_dispatch` row with `actions: write` minted per stroke.
  - **#22454** (p2 `target:v18`, Tier H): PR #22475 → `8b713fad` MERGED 2026-10-09T13:02Z (6080468777 · 6080477431 · 6080482877 · 6081456608). The published automation skill teaches the `{{ }}` delimiter in flow text slots; the out-of-scope finding is #22477 (spec lane).
  - **#22451** (p2 `tooling`, maintainer-ruled, Tier H + S): PR #22490 → `6212cc6c` MERGED 2026-10-09T14:44Z (6082600302 · 6082611344 · 6082619472 · 6083251714). **`HUMAN_MERGE_LINE_THRESHOLD = 3000` is in force on `main` from that commit**: a PR over 3,000 changed lines (additions + deletions) takes the four-piece terminal set.
  - **#22478 + #22167** (p3 `tooling`, W3 of #22060 under #22453's letter A; #22167's remainder on the same branch, claim 6088380960): PR #22531 → `6a3f82ef` MERGED 2026-10-10T00:40Z on `os-zhuang`'s APPROVED (5476495352) and their own ready / arm / enqueue (6088468843 · 6088478671 · 6088486216 · landing notes 6091761596 on #22478 and 6091768142 on #22167). `main` carries `dispatch-gates.mjs` at 15,927 lines beside `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` (1,258, no logic) and `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` (13,538, fast / slow tiers), the wrapper fast on a dev box and both tiers in CI, the `--tier` note in ruling C's meaning. **The ruling-208 freeze on `dispatch-gates.mjs` is restored** (the W3 lift was for exactly this split).
- **NOT MEASURED, carried (one line each, the reading named with its taker):** the merge-commit author of a real `pr_update_branch` sync — the next PR whose base must be brought in without a local conflict; the first live `label-write.mjs --release` — the triage seat's, on the first silent claim; the first live `workflow_dispatch` stroke — the lane that needs #22014's shard-timings refresh; the post-split coverage battery on PR #22531's final head — the next dev on `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, with their first fast-tier run (the before / after readings stand one commit earlier: 245/245 declarations, 253 → 248 zero blocks).
- **#22060 program state:** W1 → #22452 (queued); W2 measured done on `da159f74e6` (0 ceiling-0 rows, nothing to file); W3 → ruled A at #22453, landed as #22478; W4–W7 one per fire, none filed. The progress record on the anchor is 6078355912; the anchor keeps `tracking` and no `pm:*` state and never queues.
- **Landed in shift 1 (R1), closed out:** PR #22382 (#22372, p2 `bug`, Tier H) → `191543456f` MERGED 2026-10-09T01:35Z (6072073121 · 6072079471 · 6072085576 · 6072501210).
- **Inherited from r151, still standing (pointers, not restated):** the observations for the maintainer (the session classifier refusing an `os-dev` subagent's `label-write` in 3 of 4 cases — now a card, #22467; a dev commit under a non-fleet git identity — the cloud container cannot mint the fleet identity for `git`; `post-stamped`'s size route; the 2026-10-07 merge-queue head stall); the cross-lane memos (#22290 is the spec seat's; #22172 still carries `pm:dispatched` as the director seat's close-out residue, ⛔ not this seat's to strip; closed #21959 · #21992 · #21929 still carry the assignee `os-steve`, harmless). The platform readings r151 kept, and this session's (Notes), belong in `references/platform-readings.md` through #22452 (W1) or a skills PR when the lane has capacity.

## Hot-file serial queue

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`: **FROZEN** (ruling 208 R6) — the W3 lift spent and closed by `6a3f82ef`; `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` and `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` beside it are new files under the same ruling's reading (data and tests, not the engine) — the successor reads ruling 208 before touching either. `scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`: FREE.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` (469/469): RESERVED for #22452 (W1, queued). `rest-channel.md` (82/82) · `landing-operations.md` (101/101) · `triage-duties.md` (120/120) · `seat-lifecycle.md` (96/96) · `SKILL.md` (319/319) · `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (402/402): FREE, each at its ceiling — an edit is a swap, not a growth.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/{ops,validate,execute,dispatch}.mjs` · `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml` · `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` · `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` · `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` · `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` · `AGENTS.md`: FREE (this shift's rows all LANDED).
- `skills/objectstack-automation/**` · `skills/objectstack-query/**`: FREE; `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`: FREE at its ceiling (headroom 0). Every other file of the lane on both boards: FREE; at the sign-off read no open PR of any lane touches `skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` or `docs/adr/**` on objectstack (9 open PRs' file lists) or objectui (3 open PRs' file lists).

## Notes

- **Job description and write paths.** `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name` with `=`; `--ack-through=ID` from the LAST comment page for a body refresh; every stamp is a NOW token or a declared WAS token, and a WAS later than the act's clock is refused) / `label-write.mjs` (a state transition names the state being left in `--remove`; two `pm:*` states in one target are refused — the ONE-OF guard) / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (`issue_patch`, `assign`, `unassign`, `comment_edit`, `pr_ready`, `pr_draft`, `automerge_enable`, `automerge_disable`, `pr_request_reviewers`, `pr_update_branch`, `workflow_dispatch`). Route: `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`). ⛔ No MCP write. An accepted dispatch with no run is UNCONFIRMED (exit 6) — ⛔ never re-run blind; go read the card.
- **Landing.** Non-governed = CI all green + the seat's at-tier read, through the queue (`check-expected-skips --pr N` exit 0, `check-governed-merges --pr N`, relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`); arm only after `mergeable_state` reads `clean`. Tier S (`.claude/**`) = at-tier `## Contract review` PASS in seat, then the same flip. Tier H (`skills/**`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/**`) and **any PR over 3,000 changed lines** = the four-piece set (contract review on the PR, ACCEPT on the card, `needs-user-decision` + 维护者速读 on the PR, review requested from `os-zhuang` and `hotlong` via relay `pr_request_reviewers`), the PR waits draft; on an authorized APPROVED the seat lands unless the approver already did; close-out is the seat's either way. `check-expected-skips` answers exit 3 NOT MEASURED while any check-run on the head is still `in_progress`.
- **Liveness baseline** (`mode:subagent`): dispatch → draft PR 24–31 min for one-file skill fixes at tier, 71 min for an `M` probe with a 30-family gate pass, about 3 h of working time for the 30k-line split (7 h 31 min wall-clock across two usage walls); a patch round 25 min; queue latency 17–35 min this shift; four-piece set → APPROVED 3 min to 3 h 52 min; the fleet write-pace budget is 40 writes per trailing hour per token; a container restart or a usage wall kills in-flight subagents but leaves worktrees, the shared checkout and the scratchpad — re-dispatch from the worktree by an idempotent `SendMessage`, never commit its leftovers from the seat; a 20-minute battery that straddles a wall is re-run, never trusted from memory.
- **Platform readings (this session):** the auto-mode classifier refused hold-lift comments and a close in shift 1 (even `--dry-run`) and passed the same shapes in shift 2 once the maintainer's instruction was restated in session — a reading on the classifier's context, not on the rule; the triage seat may relay a maintainer answer given in its own session and move an `awaiting` card to `pm:queue` while this seat records the same answer — read the card's current labels before a transition (the ONE-OF guard caught the stale target here); `rest-channel.md:57` still spells a bare direct merge (`PUT …/pulls/{n}/merge`) for a non-queued repository, a verb the relay refuses by construction — for #22452 or the next text PR on that file, ⛔ not a card; a ready flip re-triggers the `pull_request` workflows on the head and `mergeable_state` reads `blocked` for 60–90 s until they complete, then `clean` — arm after that read; the arm's read-back is `added_to_merge_queue` on the issue timeline (REST `auto_merge` stays null in a merge-queue repository; GraphQL answers 403 from a seat container); `runLabelWrite` step ④ re-adds a stripped label with a direct `POST` even after a relay stroke (pre-existing) — for the next `label-write` PR, ⛔ not a card; **the merge queue squashes with its own method whatever the arm said** (five landings armed with `SQUASH` by the relay or `merge` by an approver all landed as single-parent squash commits authored by the fleet bot and committed by GitHub; the repository's queue setting is not readable from a seat container) — the MERGED proof is `merged: true` + the merge commit an ancestor of `origin/main` + the PR's files byte-identical to its head, never a parent count; the human-merge line counts additions + deletions, so a refactor that moves 13k lines out of a file reads as 29k changed lines and lands by approved review by construction; the `Closing-Target Claim Guard` reads every card a PR closes — a PR carrying a second `Fixes` needs a `Claim:` on that card naming the branch, and a relay body edit (`pull_request.edited`) re-arms the guard without a push; usage walls: the wall's own 429 carries the reset time, the hourly patrol's fires queued during the wall are delivered together after the reset in order, and the devs die mid-battery while their pushed branch, worktree and PR survive.
- **Timers and subscriptions at sign-off:** patrol Routine `trig_01A7Th3nqFmnqxBCnsBXHRPu` deleted; no one-shot timer live (the first wall's recovery one-shot was deleted once the recovery ran by hand); no PR subscription live (PR #22531 merged); no remote dev session to archive. The shared checkout `/home/user/objectstack` sits at `origin/main` as fetched for the last MERGED proof, clean, no worktrees; mirror branch `claude/kind-curie-ieu43x` pushed at that commit, no seat content.
